translations.web: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.
translations.bsb: Behold, every soul belongs to Me; both father and son are Mine. The soul who sins is the one who will die.
translations.kjv: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
